p.title: Marquise Drop Choker
p.descriptionHtml:
A clean collar with one long thought. A ribbed round snake collar sits close at the base of the throat with a marquise cut stone set sideways at the front. From it, a fine chain falls about 6cm with a small pear stone halfway and another at the end.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with an open neckline so the drop falls clear.

Details

  • Length: 41cm plus a 5cm extender
  • Drop: A fine chain of approximately 6cm with one small pear stone halfway and another at the end
  • Weight: Approximately 9.3g
  • Collar: Ribbed round snake chain, approximately 2mm
  • Stone: One marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 12.3mm, set sideways at the front
  • Metal: Gold, with a PVD 18K gold coating, or silver tone
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
